BadgeClickKind.description:
Selects the click semantics for a non-Wikilink/Url body click.
Default is `Toggle` (back-compat with filter-toggle call sites).

oneOf.description:
Body clicks emit [`BadgeAction::Toggle`] — for badges that drive a
filter set. This is the default.

Body clicks emit [`BadgeAction::Clicked`] — raw click semantics for
hosts that want to decide themselves.

BadgeKind.description:
What kind of metadata a badge shows — selects its colour and its
body-click behaviour.

Most kinds only differ visually; [`Wikilink`](BadgeKind::Wikilink) and
[`Url`](BadgeKind::Url) also change the click action to
[`BadgeAction::Navigate`] / [`BadgeAction::OpenUrl`] and decorate the
label (see [`display_label`]).

oneOf.description:
A `#tag`-style label. Pair with [`tag_hue`] for a stable per-value
colour via the shells' `override_color`.
A document type (e.g. "note", "meeting").
A folder / path segment.
An author / person.

A named entity, optionally typed (e.g. `ty: Some("org")`); the type
only affects how the host routes actions, not the rendering.

ty.description: Optional entity type, carried for the host's benefit.

oneOf.description:
An internal `[[wikilink]]`. The label is drawn with a `⟶` prefix;
body clicks emit [`BadgeAction::Navigate`] with `target`.

An external URL. The label shows `host` (falling back to the badge
value when empty); body clicks emit [`BadgeAction::OpenUrl`] with
`href`.

host.description: Display host (e.g. `example.com`); empty → the value is shown.

oneOf.description: A date value.
A status value (e.g. "draft", "done").
Anything else — the default kind.

Clamp.description:
Viewport-clamp parameters for [`effective_rect`] — the unit-dependent
knobs that turn a raw viewport into a workspace area and keep panels
visible inside it.

max_frac.description:
Maximum floating size as a fraction of the workspace on each axis.

This render-time cap preserves stored geometry. Maximize bypasses it
because maximized panels project directly to the whole workspace.

outer_h.description: Subtracted from viewport height (top bar + dock chrome).

outer_w.description: Subtracted from viewport width to get the workspace width.

Color.description:
A colour as sRGB channels, wire-encoded as one canonical string.

The only accepted spelling is lowercase `#rrggbb` — the form the CSS
custom properties use. Shorthand (`#fff`), uppercase hex, and named
colours are rejected rather than tolerated, because a codec that
forgives near-misses lets drifted documents parse to near-miss colours.

Key.description:
A renderer-neutral key press.

Serializes in the authored external form: non-character keys are
snake_case strings (`"left"`, `"enter"`) and a printable key is a
one-field object (`{"char":"m"}`).

PanelCommand.description:
A window-management intent, independent of how it was expressed.

Geometry commands returned by [`command_for`] carry canonical web
magnitudes: `16.0` marks a coarse step and `1.0` marks a fine step.
[`apply_command`] translates those markers through its [`CommandStep`].

Serializes internally tagged by `kind` in snake_case:
`{"kind":"move","dx":-16.0,"dy":0.0}`, `{"kind":"minimize"}`.

restore.description: Whether hosts should restore an existing record on startup.

save_policy.description: Save timing selected by the host after reductions.

ResizePolicy.description: Policy that applies a viewport measurement change to stored panel intent.

oneOf.description:
Only the viewport measurement changes; stored panel geometry is the
user's persistent intent and remains untouched.

Stored floating geometry scales by the new/old viewport ratio, matching
the web controller's reversible resize behavior.

SavePolicy.description:
Host-selected timing for persisting changed workspace snapshots.

The policy is pure data: core never hides persistence side effects, and
hosts apply the returned [`SaveDecision`] after each reducer result.
`Manual` lets the host coalesce writes; `OnSettle` writes only completed
changes; `OnChange` writes every changed reduction. A clear/reset operation
is represented as [`SaveDecision::Clear`] so backends do not hand-code a
second persistence table.

oneOf.description: Never save automatically after reductions.
Save exactly once for settled changes.
Save once for every continuous or settled change.
